groups.title: First models (phase 1)
groups.question: Does the pipeline learn one track (specialist) and many tracks (generalist pilot)?

groups.title: Training-free baselines and controls
groups.question: Floor (random actions, untrained network) and reference (scripted driver).

groups.title: Generalist
groups.question: Can one policy trained on the generated pool drive unseen tracks (H1)?

groups.title: Blind control
groups.question: Does the agent use the look-ahead (H3)?

groups.title: Specialists
groups.question: How much time does a generalist lose against single-track specialists?

groups.title: Baseline algorithm: PQN
groups.question: Does the result depend on PPO?

groups.title: Imitation and hybrids (phase 4)
groups.question: What does help from the scripted driver change (exploratory)?

groups.title: Hyperparameter sensitivity (phase 5)
groups.question: How far does the test score move when one setting changes?

groups.title: Patched physics (phase 3)
groups.question: How much did an exploit contribute?

groups.title: Seed sensitivity (phase 6)
groups.question: How much do results vary between seeds, and do the single-seed results hold?

headline: No trained agent has been evaluated yet.
The preregistered hypotheses H1-H3 are not tested yet: they need test results from 10 generalist seeds and 5 seeds each of the blind control and the single-track ablation (0 generalist seeds so far).
